lines.zh: 我在林间穿行，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I move through the trees with light steps.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，几乎不出声。
lines.en: I cross the leaf litter almost silently.
I follow the stream up.
Body low, head forward.

lines.zh: 我尾羽绷直，转弯不减速。
lines.en: Tail feathers stiff, I turn without slowing.

lines.zh: 我从一棵倒木下面钻过去。
lines.en: I duck under a fallen log.
I go round the ferns without touching them.
I walk and watch both flanks.
I quicken; the ground is damp.

lines.zh: 我朝同伴叫了一声，继续走。
lines.en: I call once to my group and walk on.
I slide a stretch down the bank.

lines.zh: 我贴着树干走，藏住身形。
lines.en: I keep to the trunk line to stay hidden.
I cross a shallow stream.
I reach the wood's edge and stop.
I crouch in the fern without moving.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖在土里压出小洞。
lines.en: My claw tips press little pits in the soil.
Insects are calling in the wood.
I lift my head and scent the wind.
My feathers lie close to my body.

lines.zh: 几只同伴在我附近伏着。
lines.en: A few of my group crouch nearby.
I hook my claw tips into the wet soil.
Something is moving in the distance.
Slowly I flex my claws.
Morning light takes the leaves.
I hold my breath and listen to the wood.

lines.zh: 我转头看了看同伴的位置。
lines.en: I turn my head to check my group's places.
Wind passes through the clearing.

lines.zh: 我把尾羽贴着落叶压平。
lines.en: I press my tail flat to the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我们三只，从林边围过来。
lines.en: Three of us close in from the treeline.

lines.zh: 我一个人站着，可不止我一个。
lines.en: You see one of me. There is more.
I am shorter than you, and quicker.

lines.zh: 你身上只有汗味，没有同伴。
lines.en: You smell of sweat only, not of others.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步很久了。
lines.en: I have heard your steps a while.

lines.zh: 我们几个围着你，你没发现。
lines.en: A few of us have closed in. You did not notice.
Do not run. If you run, we move.

lines.zh: 我的爪子你看清了没有。
lines.en: Have you looked at my claws?
My sickle claw rests on pine needles.
Your arms will be first.

lines.zh: 我压着身子，是因为要跳。
lines.en: I crouch because I am about to spring.

lines.zh: 我们不叫，叫了就没用了。
lines.en: We do not call. Calling would spoil it.
That opened my flank.
I spring a block clear and turn.
Blood on my feathers.
It hurts; the claws remain.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我绕到它侧面。
lines.en: After that hit I circle to its flank.
A group-mate called.
I fall back behind it.

lines.zh: 后腿使不上力，我改扑侧面。
lines.en: My hind leg fails, so I go for the flank.
I will keep that in my claws.
Still standing. Legs intact.
That meat we would share.
I smell blood, and fresh.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠过去，身体很低。
lines.en: I creep closer, staying low.
Drop that meat and get behind a tree.
That is not enough for all of us.
I test a bite first.
It is still moving. Better.
I do not eat cold meat.
My group is waiting beside me.
When it is done we scatter again.
You lunged in and I sprang aside.
I am lighter than you, and hard.
Do not come up behind me.
That bump and I turn at once.
I angle aside and I am past.
You stepped on my tail feathers.
I spring a block aside.

lines.zh: 撞这么一下，我都没吭声。
lines.en: A knock like that didn't even make me hiss.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，我爪下滑了半寸。
lines.en: That knock slid my claws half an inch.
Come closer and I will not give ground.
We are four or five in this group.
We ambush together and feed together.
One of them is always on my left.
It always runs in front. I let it.
When I make a kill, I share with it.
When it was hurt, I stood watch.

lines.zh: 小的一出壳，我们就都看着。
lines.en: When the small ones hatched, we all watched.
This group does not break apart.

lines.zh: 林子那么大，也能一起过。
lines.en: The wood is vast and we cross it together.

lines.zh: 我们靠得近，也就不冷了。
lines.en: Standing close, we do not get cold.
I take up a bone.
I tear off half the meat.
This bit goes to the small ones.

lines.zh: 地上有根羽毛，不是我的。
lines.en: A feather on the ground, and not mine.
I pin it with a claw.
Too heavy to drag, so I tear it apart.
This goes into a root hollow.
That bright thing is of no interest.

lines.zh: 我叼着这东西钻过两棵树。
lines.en: I carry it through two trunks.
A group-mate comes over to share.

lines.zh: 有东西在溪边低头喝水。
lines.en: Something is drinking at the stream.
I flatten and still my tail.

lines.zh: 同伴在我右边，也伏下了。
lines.en: My group-mate on the right has crouched too.
The wind is coming our way.
It has not sensed us at all.
We split to either side and close in.
One spring covers this.
I load my hind legs.

lines.zh: 它抬起头，看了看林子里。
lines.en: It raises its head and looks into the trees.
We flatten again.
It lowers its head and drinks on.
It lowered its head. Now.
I move first; my group follows.

lines.zh: 同伴一伏一起，跟上来了。
lines.en: My group-mate drops and rises, following.
It walks the stream bank.
We follow behind the trunks.
It stops and looks back.
We all freeze.
It turns and walks on.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾上，有一把镰刀。
lines.en: There's a sickle on each toe.

lines.zh: 一片蕨挡住了它的一边。
lines.en: A fern stand blocks one side of it.
A group-mate slinks behind it.

lines.zh: 它的脚步在溪石上很响。
lines.en: Its steps ring on the stream stones.
That sound covers ours.
We close in.

lines.zh: 它呼吸急了，我数着节奏。
lines.en: Its breathing quickens; I count the rhythm.
It starts backing for the bank.

lines.zh: 那边有一块石头，能挡一下。
lines.en: There is a stone it can put its back to.
It has its back to it.
Then we come from three sides at once.
I raise a foreclaw, sickle open.
I spring onto its back.
My claws sink into its shoulder.
I cling and bite.

lines.zh: 它一甩身，我跳上它肩头。
lines.en: It bucked and I sprang to its shoulder.
A group-mate takes its leg.

lines.zh: 我扑到它背上，爪子先入。
lines.en: I land on its back, claws first.
I tear from above.
Its hand grabs my tail.
I twist free and bite again.
This one takes the side of its neck.
It lunges and we spring back.
It is up again.
We circle without stopping.
Its strength is falling away.
I come in from behind again.
At last it goes down.

lines.zh: 我从枯叶堆里探出身子。
lines.en: I lift myself out of the dead leaves.

lines.zh: 针叶林和阔叶林交界处，就是这里。
lines.en: This is where the taiga meets the forest.
I rise low against the fern fronds.
My group is a few blocks behind.
The rot gives way under my claws.
I check the treeline first.

lines.zh: 林子里的风把我的气味吹散了。
lines.en: The wood's wind scatters my scent.

lines.zh: 我把爪子在地上试了试。
lines.en: I test my claws on the ground.
A small stream runs to the east.
I go that way with soft steps.
My tail sways slowly.
This place has several ways in.
We split into two parties.
I crouch and wait for my group's signal.
A sound far off, very faint.
I raise my head and hold.

lines.zh: 火燎到羽毛，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: Fire caught my feathers and I rolled.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑落，摔在石头上。
lines.en: I slid off the bank onto stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我往上游。
lines.en: Water in my nostrils and I strike for the surface.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推进一个土坑。
lines.en: The blast flung me into a dirt hollow.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进胸口，扎得不深。
lines.en: An arrow in my chest — not deep.
Strange force locks my legs.

lines.zh: 三天没猎物，我的肋骨硌手。
lines.en: Three days without prey, my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的羽毛全竖。
lines.en: Lightning struck and every feather stood.
The ground was gone and my claws caught nothing.
